title: Khu vườn tối
about: Round x9, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("tôi muốn những bài âm thanh u tối nhưng dễ nghe để ngủ hơn, có thể thêm những giai điệu ngẫu hứng"): a garden at night: the pad and the far choir, the glass improvising first, then the plucked string answering in its own way, then the glass again. C sharp minor. Softer harmony than before (added ninths, major sevenths, no Phrygian rub), nothing sudden. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
